title: Cult of the ORS

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: WAIT! Don't step there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: WAIT! Don't step there.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Wait, hold on. Let me back up a bit. You might wanna tap the ground just in front of you there. Have you ever heard of LRHorN?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, hold on. Let me back up a bit. You might wanna tap the ground just in front of you there. Have you ever heard of LRHorN?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: It's dangerous, you know? An angry, aggressive chemical weapon that burns through anything, even skin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's dangerous, you know? An angry, aggressive chemical weapon that burns through anything, even skin.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Oh, you know, the ORS Rep asked me to hijack a shipment of air fresheners... I mean... cuz you know how bad this rig smells, and so I wonder, hey, Finlay, how you gonna get into that shipment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, you know, the ORS Rep asked me to hijack a shipment of air fresheners... I mean... cuz you know how bad this rig smells, and so I wonder, hey, Finlay, how you gonna get into that shipment?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: I was going to get myself in! That's what the Separatists do! They... ugh... separate the divisions or whatever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was going to get myself in! That's what the Separatists do! They... ugh... separate the divisions or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Like a soul trying to buy its way outta the sea. So, um, what do we do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like a soul trying to buy its way outta the sea. So, um, what do we do?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: I don't know. I like to think I'm making a difference somehow. Standing up for those who can't. You know... metaphorically or whatnot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. I like to think I'm making a difference somehow. Standing up for those who can't. You know... metaphorically or whatnot.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Really?!?! Who? Who? You have to tell me. This is it, I feel it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really?!?! Who? Who? You have to tell me. This is it, I feel it.

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Captain-what-the-who-now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Captain-what-the-who-now?

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: Whooo! I mean, any voice is a voice, and this voice is going to be on my side! For once! Oh, my Neon Gods I gotta go figure out what I'm gonna say when this goes live. YOU'RE THE BEST!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whooo! I mean, any voice is a voice, and this voice is going to be on my side! For once! Oh, my Neon Gods I gotta go figure out what I'm gonna say when this goes live. YOU'RE THE BEST!

nodes.speaker: Finlay Basin
nodes.text: I think I just need a big name behind me, you know? Someone who can vouch for my character and all those things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I just need a big name behind me, you know? Someone who can vouch for my character and all those things.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why? What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tip-toe, here we go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tip-toe, here we go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: More times than I can count.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: More times than I can count.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: More times than I can count.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: More times than I can count.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing with it?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing with it?!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you doing with it?!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you doing with it?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You were going to MELT your way in?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were going to MELT your way in?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You were going to MELT your way in?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You were going to MELT your way in?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I assume you were caught?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I assume you were caught?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Man you're bad at this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Man you're bad at this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Captain Taylor Hernz.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Captain Taylor Hernz.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's notorious. Cunning. Everything a sailor of these seas should be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's a joke. Total washup wannabe pirate who was born way too late.
